study_design: Original n30 is exploratory. The uniform additional90 expansion was prespecified AFTER outcome inspection of n30, before expanded outcomes; no cell/model/budget/metric dropped. Combined120 is the main expanded study, not an originally preregistered n120 study. Additional90 are held-out precision validation under the fixed ordering; not a new independently preregistered confirmatory experiment. B16 remains first10 seed11 only.

original_prefix_audit.equality: np.array_equal, every NPZ array; no tolerance substitutions
original_prefix_audit.timing_exclusion: Runtime and prediction seconds may change; deterministic cache row/coalition counts must match.

sensitivity_scope: prespecified first10 seed11, original results, independent of main slice; not next90 sensitivity
warnings: Exploratory/descriptive instance-cluster percentile bootstrap intervals, not finite-sample certificates; 2000 replicates.
Seeds 11,23,47 are fixed, not sampled model-training replicates; LR seeds are not independent fitted-model evidence.
Repeated explanations and repetition pairs are not independent instance observations.
Boundary bootstrap intervals may collapse at 0 or 1; narrow/collapsed intervals do not certify reliability.

ACS random-person scanning with household deduplication induces unequal household selection; sampling justification is absent. ACS intervals and Hoeffding values are descriptive, not unconditional certificates or survey-weighted population inference.
German uses an approximate two-pool reference, not ground truth; all German match/error metrics concern reference agreement only, never true accuracy or certification.
Reference-gap strata are descriptive, oracle-dependent, and conditional on the empirical game; not deployable selectors.
B16 changes the background and hence the estimand; compare each estimate to its own recomputed target.

Kernel control is plain constrained least squares without L1 feature selection. At budgets covering the cube it enumerates the full exact game, rather than sampling; cost is capped at 2**d background-averaged rows.
Cached actual rows and timings include reference construction and all estimators, and cannot be assigned to individual methods or interpreted as deployment timings.

Cell/seed/gap percentile intervals are marginal descriptive intervals. Effect comparisons additionally receive simultaneous max-deviation bootstrap bands across the reported exact-game contrast family; these bands remain descriptive and may degenerate at boundaries.

Original n30 is exploratory. The uniform additional90 expansion was prespecified AFTER outcome inspection of n30, before expanded outcomes; no cell/model/budget/metric dropped. Combined120 is the main expanded study, not an originally preregistered n120 study. Additional90 are held-out precision validation under the fixed ordering; not a new independently preregistered confirmatory experiment. B16 remains first10 seed11 only.

definitions.top3_match: Unordered set equality of three largest absolute attributions vs target; stable index tie-break; runs then fixed seeds averaged within instance.
definitions.pairwise_top3_match: Fraction of the 190 unordered within-game repetition pairs with equal top-3 subsets; average fixed seeds within instance; do not count pairs as samples.
definitions.absolute_l1: sum_j |estimate_j-reference_j| in probability units; mean over runs.
definitions.normalized_l1: Absolute L1 / max(sum_j |reference_j|,0.01), computed per game before averaging.
definitions.material_sign_agreement: Fraction of reference features with |phi_j|>=0.01 whose sign is recovered; undefined when none; equal available-seed average within instance and equal valid-instance mean; coverage and valid n reported.
definitions.nogueira_stability: 1 - mean_j [R/(R-1)*p_j*(1-p_j)] / [q*(1-q)], R=20, top3 selection frequency p_j and q=3/d. Never clipped; computed per fixed game, then averaged.
definitions.efficiency_residual: Mean absolute sum(estimate)-sum(reference); stored max antithetic residual also in resources table.
definitions.reference_pool_top3_agreement: German independent 512-cycle pools: top3 equality, not true-reference accuracy.
definitions.gap_bin: Reference absolute rank3-minus-rank4 gap: <.002, [.002,.01), >=.01. Per seed-instance game; average selected games using cluster-bootstrap ratios.
definitions.uncertainty: 2000 paired instance-cluster bootstrap replicates; same indices within dataset across all methods/models/budgets/fixed seeds. Independent dataset streams. Percentile 2.5/97.5 intervals; undefined bootstrap ratios omitted and counted.
definitions.exact_macro: Equal mean over six dataset-model cells (pima/acs x lr/rf/mlp); each seed/run mean within instance; bootstrap instances independently across datasets, shared across models within dataset.
definitions.multiple_comparisons: All exact antithetic-minus-controls and P64-minus-P1 contrasts, including macro contrasts, use one 95% max-centered-absolute-deviation paired-bootstrap simultaneous band. Marginal intervals also reported; no unadjusted significance/certification claims.
definitions.hoeffding: max(0,mean-sqrt(log(24/.05)/(2*n))), one-sided Bonferroni sample-size illustration over 24 exact antithetic dataset/model/budget cells. ACS sampling assumptions unverified; not an unconditional certificate.
definitions.costs: Permutation/iid logical rows per run B*(2+2P*(d-1)); kernel rows capped at B*2**d on full enumeration. Actual cached rows/timings aggregate shared game reference and estimator work. train_seconds/prediction_seconds are wall timings despite names.
